main_text.p: urbanis accidunt, de [?]sciis quoque: ad hæc accipienda tributa, cura navalium & rerum sacrarum sustinenda. Horum au-tem senatorum munus ex lege annuum tantum fuit, quanquàm concilium ipsum in republica instituti fuerit per-petui. Senatorum designatio quotannis fiebat hoc modo. Curatores aut præfecti tribuum singularum stato anni die ante ineuntem mensem Hecatom-bæonem nomina omnium tribulium suorum, qui vel per ætatem vel per classem honoris hujus capaces erant, honoremque petebant, in vas unum huic rei aptum conjiciebant, in vas alterum totidem fabas, quarum c erant albæ, liquæ omnes nigræ, inferebant. Tum ordine nomina singulorum cum singulis fabis ex utrâque urnâ extrahebantur, & quorum nomina cum fabis albis exibant, illi senatores intelligebantur designari. Sic ex quatuor tribubus numerus senatorum cccc complebatur: totaque hæc res incertæ fortis erat, sine suffragiis. Deinde ex omni senatorum [illegible, ~6 letters]ovorum numero Prytanes etiam for-[?] [illegible, ~1 letter]ò defignabantur, qui quasi compen-[?] [illegible, ~2 letters]um totius senatus conficiebant; to-amque[?] senatum velut principes ejus regebant, five xl five l. Hoc enim pa-rum ex veteris monumentis, quoad So-lonis

page.notes: Partly illegible passage at the lower left, where the text is obscured by red bleed from the neighbouring page; the words marked [?] and the illegible fragments there are uncertain. "de sciis" in the first line is uncertain (possibly "de sociis"); "five" in "sive xl five l." is uncertain. The Greek fragment before "defignabantur" could not be read and is marked illegible. Faint marks at the left edge (near "totidem" and "liquæ") are bleed from the neighbouring page, not notes.
